words.gloss: those who do not hide what they have

literal: Because of the existence in the world of those who do not hide, those who beg undertake to stand in front.
translation: It is only because there are people in this world who do not hide their wealth that others undertake the act of standing before them to beg.
modern: பிறருக்குக் கொடுக்காமல் மறைக்காதவர்கள் இவ்வுலகில் இருப்பதால்தான், இரப்பவர்கள் அவர்களிடம் நேரில் நின்று யாசிப்பதை மேற்கொள்கிறார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet explains the social dynamic that keeps the act of asking for charity alive. The poet states that begging is only practiced because there exist generous people ('கரப்பிலார்') in the world ('வையகத்து') who do not hide their resources when asked. It is this existence ('உண்மையால்') that gives the needy the hope and courage to stand face-to-face ('கண்ணின்று') and make their request. Without the presence of such open-handed givers, the act of begging ('இரப்பவர் மேற்கொள்வது') would disappear entirely.
